name: Termini
tagline: Online zakazivanje za salone, brijačnice i stomatologe
description: Klijenti sami zakažu termin preko linka ili QR koda, bez aplikacije i poziva. Podsjetnik stiže na WhatsApp 24 i 2 sata prije, a ako klijent nema WhatsApp, šalje se SMS. Kalendar za cijeli tim, usluge, radno vrijeme i uvoz kontakata.

en.tagline: Online booking for salons, barbers and dentists
en.description: Clients book their own appointment through a link or QR code, with no app and no phone call. Reminders go out on WhatsApp 24 and 2 hours before, with SMS as a fallback for clients without WhatsApp. Team calendar, services, opening hours and contact import.
